tools.name: lobby.signup
tools.title: identity: signup
tools.description: Registers a seat for an AID whose OOBI is hosted elsewhere: resolves it through KERIA, persists the member, and replies ok or (error reason). Use signup-with-icp when the browser holds its own KEL. [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

oobi-url.description: the KERIA-hosted OOBI URL where this AID's key state can be resolved

tools.name: lobby.signup-with-icp
tools.title: identity: signup-with-icp
tools.description: Takes a seat for a browser-made AID from its inception event and signatures, verified offline (AID = k[0], SAID, sig) and witnessed into ^oobi-host; replies ok or (error reason). [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

icp-alist.description: the AID's inception event as a JSON object (KERI icp fields, serialized)

sigs.description: a JSON array of CESR qb64 signatures over the event, one per signing key

tools.name: lobby.signup-with-kel
tools.title: identity: signup-with-kel
tools.description: Takes a seat under an AID's whole KEL (inception, sigs, rotations in sn order), verified end to end and witnessed into ^oobi-host; replies ok or (error reason). No rotations: use signup-with-icp. [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

icp-alist.description: the AID's inception event as a JSON object (KERI icp fields, serialized)

sigs.description: a JSON array of CESR qb64 signatures over the event, one per signing key

rotations.description: a JSON array of the AID's rotation events after inception, each a KERI rot object

tools.name: lobby.extend-kel
tools.title: identity: extend-kel
tools.description: Appends rotations continuing from this gateway's last held event for a witnessed AID, each verified against stored state; replies ok or (error reason). Public: a rotation proves its own authorship. [identity; callable by anyone]

rotations.description: a JSON array of the AID's rotation events after inception, each a KERI rot object

tools.name: lobby.witness-kel
tools.title: identity: witness-kel
tools.description: Records a verifiable KEL into ^oobi-host without a seat, levelling a known AID up and refusing a different history under one AID; replies ok or (error reason). Call join afterwards for a seat. [identity; callable by anyone]

icp-alist.description: the AID's inception event as a JSON object (KERI icp fields, serialized)

sigs.description: a JSON array of CESR qb64 signatures over the event, one per signing key

rotations.description: a JSON array of the AID's rotation events after inception, each a KERI rot object

tools.name: lobby.join
tools.title: identity: join
tools.description: Grants a seat in this gateway's universal commune to an AID already witnessed in ^oobi-host (empty username mints a handle); replies ok or (error reason). The seat is what keri-authenticate checks. [identity; callable by anyone]

username.description: the seat's login handle, a plain string chosen at signup

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

tools.name: lobby.has-seat
tools.title: identity: has-seat
tools.description: Replies #t when the AID holds a seat on this gateway and #f otherwise, so a client can tell whether to join before authenticating. [identity; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.register-oobi-replies
tools.title: identity: register-oobi-replies
tools.description: Attaches the AID's self-endorsed OKEA endpoint replies (/end/role/add, /loc/scheme) to its served OOBI after each frame verifies under its current key; replies ok or (error reason). [identity; callable by anyone]

replies.description: a JSON array of CESR-framed OKEA endpoint reply events (/end/role/add, /loc/scheme)

tools.name: lobby.fetch-icp
tools.title: identity: fetch-icp
tools.description: Replies the stored ^oobi-host entry (ICP plus rotations) for an AID, or #f when unknown, so a new browser can import the AID and unlock it with its bran, which is the only proof asked. [identity; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.find-icp
tools.title: identity: find-icp
tools.description: Replies the stored ^oobi-host entry (ICP plus rotations) one of whose events carries the given qb64 key as its signing key, the earliest registered when several, or #f when none, so a browser holding only a passcode finds the log by the passcode's first key, verifies it and checks the passcode opens it. [identity; callable by anyone]

event-key.description: a qb64 public key an identity's log carries as a signing key, in an event's k[0] — the first key a passcode derives is one

tools.name: lobby.keri-challenge
tools.title: identity: keri-challenge
tools.description: Auth step 1: mints a 32-byte random nonce bound to the AID prefix and replies it as hex; the nonce expires after 120 seconds and is spent on first use. [identity; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.keri-authenticate
tools.title: identity: keri-authenticate
tools.description: Auth step 2: verifies the signed nonce under the AID's current key, checks the AID holds a seat, and replies (ok session) with a root-tier ^lobby-session bound to that AID, or (error reason). [identity; callable by anyone]

nonce.description: the 32-byte challenge from keri-challenge as lowercase hex; expires 120 s after issue

tools.name: lobby.keri-authenticate-device
tools.title: identity: keri-authenticate-device
tools.description: Auth step 2 for an enrolled device: verifies the root-signed device credential, its live enrollment and the nonce signature; replies (ok session) at tier device within its doors, or an error. [identity; callable by anyone]

wire-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

nonce.description: the 32-byte challenge from keri-challenge as lowercase hex; expires 120 s after issue

tools.name: lobby.corpus-search
tools.title: knowledge: corpus-search
tools.description: Searches one corpus domain, or every built domain when domain is #f, by embedding similarity; replies ((hits . rows)) ranked by score up to limit, or ((error . reason)) when corpus search is off here. [knowledge; callable by anyone]

domain.description: on corpus-search a corpus domain name or #f for all; on open the ballot domain (policy, recomposition, …)

limit.description: the maximum number of results to reply

tools.name: lobby.corpus-domains
tools.title: knowledge: corpus-domains
tools.description: Replies ((domains . names)) listing the corpus domains built on this gateway, or ((error . reason)) when corpus search is off, so the corpus tab lists them without hardcoding. [knowledge; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.leave
tools.title: chat: leave
tools.description: Marks a display name offline, drops it from every meeting room it was in, broadcasts the change, and replies the list of names still online. [chat; callable by anyone]

name.description: on announce/leave the caller's display name; on declare-place the human name of the new place; on declare-need/declare-means the row's own display name, default SPEC (need) or "AGENT's SPEC" (means)

tools.name: lobby.who
tools.title: chat: who
tools.description: Replies the display names currently announced as online on this gateway; the same read as online-users. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.signal
tools.title: chat: signal
tools.description: Relays a WebRTC signalling message (offer, answer, ICE candidate) from one display name to another's inbox and replies sent, or peer-not-found when the target is offline. [chat; callable by anyone]

target-name.description: the display name of the peer the signal or introduction is addressed to

from-name.description: the display name of the peer sending the signal

signal-type.description: the WebRTC signal kind, one of walkie-offer, walkie-answer, walkie-ice, walkie-cam (on or off: whether the sender is sending video) or invite, room-suffixed

signal-data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: lobby.room-roster
tools.title: chat: room-roster
tools.description: Replies the display names currently in a meeting room (a topic string); joining a room is an act done through the authenticated session, this door only reads. [chat; callable by anyone]

room.description: a meeting-room topic string; its roster is who the walkie meshes over

tools.name: lobby.live-rooms
tools.title: chat: live-rooms
tools.description: Replies every meeting room with anyone in it as ((room . names) ...), the always-on index the meeting wake reads. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.ice-servers
tools.title: chat: ice-servers
tools.description: Replies the ICE servers WebRTC peers find each other through, as a list of alists: "urls" always, "username" and "credential" when a relay wants them. The gateway's configuration decides the list; a client carries none of its own. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.vapid-public-key
tools.title: chat: vapid-public-key
tools.description: Replies the web-push VAPID public key in base64, or "" when push is off on this gateway, so the browser knows whether to subscribe. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.register-push
tools.title: chat: register-push
tools.description: Stores a device's web-push subscription JSON under its device id in the push store when one is configured and replies ok either way. [chat; callable by anyone]

device-id.description: the push subscription's device identifier chosen by the browser

subscription-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: lobby.unregister-push
tools.title: chat: unregister-push
tools.description: Removes a device's web-push subscription from the push store when one is configured and replies ok either way. [chat; callable by anyone]

device-id.description: the push subscription's device identifier chosen by the browser

tools.name: lobby.get-mailbox
tools.title: operations: get-mailbox
tools.description: Answers the removed-role-gate error so an old client hears why mailbox access has no wiring; the authenticated session's mesh mailbox doors serve deliveries. [operations; callable by anyone]

identity-key.description: a KERI AID prefix or legacy org pubkey naming the caller; the gate is removed, always errors

tools.name: lobby.online-users
tools.title: chat: online-users
tools.description: Replies the display names connected to this gateway right now, which the contact book joins onto its online dot; presence is gateway-local. [chat; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.donation-address
tools.title: operations: donation-address
tools.description: Replies the Monero address of the wallet this gateway is wired to, so anyone can donate toward hosting, or #f when no wallet is configured or the read fails. [operations; callable by anyone]

tools.name: lobby.has-role?
tools.title: governance: has-role?
tools.description: Replies #f for every AID and role: the role-credential ceremony it read is gone, and the reply shape stays so an old client keeps working. [governance; callable by anyone]

role.description: a role name; the role ceremony is removed, so has-role? always replies #f

tools.name: lobby.get-result
tools.title: governance: get-result
tools.description: Replies a proposal's public tally: (closed . tally-record) for a recorded ballot, (open . live-result) for one still open, or (error ...) for an unknown id. [governance; callable by anyone]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

tools.name: lobby.list-proposals
tools.title: governance: list-proposals
tools.description: Replies ((proposal-id . status) ...) for every governance proposal, status open or closed, readable without a seat. [governance; callable by anyone]

tools.name: session.whoami
tools.title: identity: whoami
tools.description: Replies the AID prefix this session cap is bound to, so the browser can check the cap it holds is the identity it expects. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.leave
tools.title: chat: leave
tools.description: Unbinds this AID's `browser` channel from the recipient registry and tells presence NAME has left; replies presence's answer. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

name.description: on announce/leave the caller's display name; on declare-place the human name of the new place; on declare-need/declare-means the row's own display name, default SPEC (need) or "AGENT's SPEC" (means)

tools.name: session.join-room
tools.title: chat: join-room
tools.description: Puts this AID itself on the roster of meeting ROOM (a non-empty string) via presence, so the walkie offers it mic connections; replies presence's answer or () when nothing was joined. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

room.description: a meeting-room topic string; its roster is who the walkie meshes over

tools.name: session.leave-room
tools.title: chat: leave-room
tools.description: Takes this AID itself off the roster of meeting ROOM via presence; replies presence's answer or () when no presence or room was named. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

room.description: a meeting-room topic string; its roster is who the walkie meshes over

tools.name: session.register-push
tools.title: chat: register-push
tools.description: Binds a `push` channel for DEVICE-ID under this AID and stores SUBSCRIPTION-JSON in the push store, so the notification router can reach this device; replies ok. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

device-id.description: the push subscription's device identifier chosen by the browser

subscription-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.unregister-push
tools.title: chat: unregister-push
tools.description: Unbinds DEVICE-ID's `push` channel from this AID and drops its subscription from the push store; replies ok. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

device-id.description: the push subscription's device identifier chosen by the browser

tools.name: session.present-contact-point
tools.title: identity: present-contact-point
tools.description: Presents this AID's own contact-point credential WIRE (self-issued, blinded, signed): the commune checks it is the presenter's, of a kind it delivers on, and sends a code to the address itself. Replies (ok . pending), or an error. The channel binds on confirm-contact-point. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.confirm-contact-point
tools.title: identity: confirm-contact-point
tools.description: Binds the presented (KIND CTX) channel under this AID when CODE is the code the commune sent to that address; replies (ok . #t), or an error for a wrong or lapsed code. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

ctx.description: the notification channel's destination address for KIND (an email, a push endpoint, …)

code.description: a label's code: the six characters a resource is known by in its scope

tools.name: session.withdraw-contact-point
tools.title: identity: withdraw-contact-point
tools.description: Erases the (KIND CTX) channel bound under this AID and puts down one still waiting for its code — the deletion path for a contact point; replies (ok . #t). [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

ctx.description: the notification channel's destination address for KIND (an email, a push endpoint, …)

tools.name: session.my-contact-points
tools.title: identity: my-contact-points
tools.description: Replies ((delivers . kinds) (points . rows)): the kinds this commune delivers on, and this AID's durable channels as (kind ctx state) with state bound or pending. Live browser and push bindings, which reconnects rebuild, stay out. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.sync-contacts
tools.title: chat: sync-contacts
tools.description: Stores DATA as the server-side backup of this AID's browser-held contact book (512 KiB cap); replies ok or an error with the failure. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-contacts
tools.title: chat: list-contacts
tools.description: Replies the server-side backup of this AID's contact book as stored by sync-contacts, or () when none is held. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.sync-log
tools.title: commitments: sync-log
tools.description: Stores DATA, the browser's opaque JSON captain's log, as this AID's server-side backup; replies ok or an error with the failure. [commitments; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-log
tools.title: commitments: list-log
tools.description: Replies this AID's captain's log backup as the opaque JSON string sync-log stored, or "" when none is held. [commitments; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.sync-pins
tools.title: slots: sync-pins
tools.description: Stores DATA as this AID's pin book backup and folds the lists marked shared into the scope's `^pins` aggregator; replies ok or an error with the failure. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-pins
tools.title: slots: list-pins
tools.description: Replies this AID's pin book as the JSON string sync-pins stored, or "" when none is held. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.our-pin-lists
tools.title: slots: our-pin-lists
tools.description: Lists the commune's shared pin lists read off the `^pins` fold, or () when no pin fold is wired. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.our-pins
tools.title: slots: our-pins
tools.description: Replies the members of one shared pin list LIST-ID read off the `^pins` fold, or () when no pin fold is wired. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

list-id.description: the id of one shared pin list off the ^pins fold

tools.name: session.sync-taxonomy
tools.title: knowledge: sync-taxonomy
tools.description: Stores DATA as this AID's taxonomy cut and contributes it to the scope's folksonomy aggregator, since publishing a cut is voting; replies ok or an error. [knowledge; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-taxonomy
tools.title: knowledge: list-taxonomy
tools.description: Replies this AID's published taxonomy cut as stored by sync-taxonomy, or () when none is held. [knowledge; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.folksonomy-template
tools.title: knowledge: folksonomy-template
tools.description: Replies the commune's aggregated taxonomy cut as a {id,label,children,count} template, weighted toward LENS (a name resolved against this AID's own contact book) when given, or the global cut. [knowledge; callable by an enrolled device]

lens.description: a named cut of the taxonomy, resolved against this AID's own contact book; absent = the global cut

tools.name: session.adopt-lens
tools.title: knowledge: adopt-lens
tools.description: Resolves LENS's (or, absent, the global) aggregated cut server-side, flattens it to structure edges and publishes it as this AID's own taxonomy cut; replies ok, or () when no folksonomy is wired. [knowledge; callable by an enrolled device]

lens.description: a named cut of the taxonomy, resolved against this AID's own contact book; absent = the global cut

tools.name: session.profile
tools.title: identity: profile
tools.description: Replies this AID's member record as an alist of username, display-name and email, or #f when the AID holds no seat. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.update-profile
tools.title: identity: update-profile
tools.description: Sets this AID's own DISPLAY-NAME and EMAIL on its member record, validating a non-empty email; replies ok or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

display-name.description: the profile's display name shown to others

email.description: the seat's contact email, display-only on the member record

tools.name: session.fp-status
tools.title: identity: fp-status
tools.description: Replies (ok . alist) with this AID's personhood standing in SCOPE-ID: person, governor, whether personhood is bootstrapped, and the verified count. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-vouch
tools.title: identity: fp-vouch
tools.description: Issues an unsigned relationship credential from this AID for SUBJECT-AID with relation REL, ending prior vouches; replies (ok . #t) or an error. Prefer fp-vouch-signed when the browser can sign. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

rel.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.fp-vouch-preimage
tools.title: identity: fp-vouch-preimage
tools.description: Replies (ok fields), the SAID-relevant fields of the relationship credential this AID would issue for SUBJECT-AID at AT, so the browser re-derives the SAID and signs it for fp-vouch-signed. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

rel.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.fp-vouch-signed
tools.title: identity: fp-vouch-signed
tools.description: Rebuilds the vouch from the same wire args, verifies SIGNATURE is this AID's own, ends prior vouches for SUBJECT-AID and issues it; replies (ok said) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

rel.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.fp-withdraw-vouch
tools.title: identity: fp-withdraw-vouch
tools.description: Ends every standing vouch from this AID for SUBJECT-AID; the vouch is the voucher's own to end. Replies (ok . #t), also when none stood. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.relationships
tools.title: identity: relationships
tools.description: Replies (ok . rows), one row per person in this AID's contact book: whether they are recognised, the kind this AID's standing vouch for them states (mine), the kind theirs for this AID states (theirs), and their open ask to be recognised in SCOPE-ID. A row names only what stands between the two. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.give-card
tools.title: identity: give-card
tools.description: Keeps this AID's card for SUBJECT-AID, someone in its contacts: WIRE is {from,to,at,sealed,said,sig}, its content sealed to the receiver and its identifier signed by the giver. The commune checks the signature and keeps the ciphertext, in place of any earlier card to that person. Replies (ok . #t) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.withdraw-card
tools.title: identity: withdraw-card
tools.description: Erases this AID's card for SUBJECT-AID; replies (ok . #t), also when none stood. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.cards
tools.title: identity: cards
tools.description: Replies (ok . rows), one row per person in this AID's contact book with a card either way: the card they gave (its wire, sealed to this AID) and when this AID's own card to them was made. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-request-enroll
tools.title: identity: fp-request-enroll
tools.description: Opens this AID's own enrollment ceremony in SCOPE-ID's ecosystem at the policy's quorum, durable on every witness rail; replies (ok . #t) or an error when already recognised. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-pending
tools.title: identity: fp-pending
tools.description: Replies (ok . rows), the standing enrollment asks in SCOPE-ID's ecosystem with each candidate's progress and vouchers, after expiring stale ones. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-my-ceremony
tools.title: identity: fp-my-ceremony
tools.description: Replies (ok . alist) with this AID's own ask: state none, collecting (count, quorum, witnesses, vouchers) or finalized. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-grant
tools.title: identity: fp-grant
tools.description: The genesis act: a governor issues personhood to CANDIDATE-AID in an ecosystem where nobody is recognised yet; replies (ok . #t) or an error once personhood is bootstrapped. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.fp-open-ceremony
tools.title: identity: fp-open-ceremony
tools.description: A recognised person introduces CANDIDATE-AID by opening their enrollment ceremony at the ecosystem's quorum with this AID as sponsor (K is ignored); replies (ok . #t) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

k.description: a requested quorum count; ignored, the ecosystem's own personhood quorum applies

tools.name: session.my-phc
tools.title: identity: my-phc
tools.description: Replies (ok . wire), this AID's live personhood credential as a portable card with the issuer's signature, or (ok . #f) when the AID holds none. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.present-phc
tools.title: identity: present-phc
tools.description: Verifies a personhood credential WIRE from another gateway (holder is this AID, issuer signature, trusted issuer) and imports it; replies (ok . #t) or an error. present-bundle takes a whole bundle. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.my-vouches
tools.title: identity: my-vouches
tools.description: Replies (ok . json), the portable bundle this AID carries to another gateway: personhoods, vouches, issuer blessings and key logs, or "" when there is nothing to carry. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.present-bundle
tools.title: identity: present-bundle
tools.description: Verifies a bundle WIRE from elsewhere in dependency order and imports it only when every card stands; replies (ok . newly-imported) or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

wire.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.sync-credentials
tools.title: identity: sync-credentials
tools.description: Stores DATA, the browser's bran-sealed credential blob the gateway cannot read, as this AID's zero-knowledge backup; replies ok or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

data.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.list-credential-backups
tools.title: identity: list-credential-backups
tools.description: Replies the sealed credential backup blob sync-credentials stored for this AID, which the browser decrypts client-side on a fresh device, or () when none is held. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.store-shamir-shares
tools.title: identity: store-shamir-shares
tools.description: Parks the guardian recovery SHARES with SOURCE-AID and THRESHOLD in this AID's user file for later reconstruction; replies ok or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

threshold.description: the number of Shamir shares needed to reconstruct the bran

shares.description: a JSON array of the bran's Shamir shares, each addressed to a contact's AID

tools.name: session.get-shamir-shares
tools.title: identity: get-shamir-shares
tools.description: Replies the guardian recovery shares parked for this AID as an alist of source, threshold and shares, or () when none are held. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.tier
tools.title: identity: tier
tools.description: Replies root or device: whether the passcode key or an enrolled device key proved this session. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-devices
tools.title: identity: my-devices
tools.description: Lists the devices this AID's root has authorized, each as a wire alist. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.revoke-device
tools.title: identity: revoke-device
tools.description: Retires the device credential SAID from this AID's registry from either tier, so a lost phone is revoked from the laptop; replies ok or an error when no such device exists. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.relay-announce!
tools.title: chat: relay-announce!
tools.description: Verifies a browser-signed Reticulum announce PACKET-HEX against this AID's KEL-anchored mesh pubkey, registers its destination and forwards it under a 30-per-60 s budget; replies ok or an error. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

packet-hex.description: a signed Reticulum announce or DATA packet as lowercase hex bytes

tools.name: session.send-mesh-packet!
tools.title: chat: send-mesh-packet!
tools.description: Transmits a browser-composed mesh DATA packet PACKET-HEX through the bridge under the same 30-per-60 s budget, refusing any other packet type; replies ok or an error. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

packet-hex.description: a signed Reticulum announce or DATA packet as lowercase hex bytes

tools.name: session.drain-mesh-mailbox
tools.title: chat: drain-mesh-mailbox
tools.description: Drains the ciphertext held for every destination derived from this AID's KEL-anchored mesh pubkey; replies ((dest-hex . #(payload-hex ...)) ...) with only non-empty mailboxes. [chat; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.list-credentials
tools.title: identity: list-credentials
tools.description: Lists the credentials in this gateway's own store whose holder is this AID, or () when no store is wired. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.issue-credential
tools.title: identity: issue-credential
tools.description: Issues an ACDC this AID authored (issuer must match the caller) into this gateway's store; refuses unless the caller holds governor standing. Replies the credential's SAID, or an error. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

cred-alist-raw.description: a browser-built, browser-signed ACDC as a JSON object; issuance gate is removed, always errors

tools.name: session.revoke-credential
tools.title: identity: revoke-credential
tools.description: Revokes the credential named by SAID; refuses unless the caller holds governor standing. Governance may revoke any credential by policy, not only ones it issued itself. [identity; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.open
tools.title: governance: open
tools.description: Opens a ballot or expression proposal ID in DOMAIN under FRANCHISE as this governor AID, snapshotting voice weights; TARGET-IDS is required when KIND is expression (the distribution's own targets), ignored for a ballot; SUBJECT is an optional "kind:id" the forum resolves against. Replies (ok id) or an error when the id is already open or closed. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

domain.description: on corpus-search a corpus domain name or #f for all; on open the ballot domain (policy, recomposition, …)

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

franchise.description: who votes: the symbol federation, or the list (scope SCOPE-ID)

target-ids.description: a JSON document, as a string

subject.description: a "kind:id" string the forum resolves an open proposal against, e.g. "recipe:bread"

tools.name: session.cast
tools.title: governance: cast
tools.description: Casts this AID's unsigned stance ARG on proposal ID and issues a stance credential; replies ok or an error. Use cast-signed when the client can sign. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

arg.description: the legacy stance: a position symbol (yes, no, …) for a ballot, a distribution map for an expression

tools.name: session.stance-preimage
tools.title: governance: stance-preimage
tools.description: Replies (ok fields), the SAID fields of the stance credential this AID would cast on ID with POSITION, so the client re-derives the SAID and signs it for cast-signed. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

position.description: the ballot position the caller takes, sent as a symbol name such as yes or no

tools.name: session.cast-signed
tools.title: governance: cast-signed
tools.description: Casts POSITION on ID under the client's own signature over the stance-preimage fields, U echoed back from stance-preimage's own claims, verified against this AID's current KEL key (resolved server-side, never a caller argument); replies ok or an error, including when U is missing. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

position.description: the ballot position the caller takes, sent as a symbol name such as yes or no

tools.name: session.part-stance-preimage
tools.title: governance: part-stance-preimage
tools.description: Replies (ok fields), the SAID fields of the plan-part stance credential this AID would cast on SCOPE-ID with HAND-JSON, a JSON object of part-string (parts.scm grammar, e.g. "process=bake;place=town") to a signed portion in [-1, 1]; the client re-derives the SAID and signs it for cast-part-signed. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

hand-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.cast-part-signed
tools.title: governance: cast-part-signed
tools.description: Casts this AID's HAND of stances on parts of SCOPE-ID's plan under the client's own signature over the part-stance-preimage fields (U echoed back), revokes the AID's previous hand there, and hands the scope's standing hands to the planner's voice fold; replies ok or an error. docs/planning/voice/voice-follows-work.md. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

hand-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.declare-span
tools.title: custody: declare-span
tools.description: Declares, for SCOPE-AID and as one of its governors, that RESOURCE-ID's service pool stands at PLACE (a span declaration, issuer = holder = the scope, live until UNTIL when given); a solve reads the standing declarations through the consent gate (a foreign place needs the host's hosting willingness). Replies (ok said) or an error. [custody; callable by an enrolled device]

resource-id.description: an economic-resource id in the scope (own-means: the titled thing; claim/resource-detail: the good)

tools.name: session.admit-commune
tools.title: governance: admit-commune
tools.description: Admits the commune COMMUNE-AID into the federation FEDERATION-AID this gateway holds, at the sturdyref its peer answers at, as one of the federation's governors (the federation's own ladder decides whether it recognises the caller, and its governance policy may require the commune's consent as RATIFICATION, a SAID). The goods that cross are not named: the commune tells the federation what it deals in. Replies ok or an error. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

sturdyref-uri.description: the sturdyref the commune's peer answers at, an ocapn:// URI

tools.name: session.declare-hosting
tools.title: custody: declare-hosting
tools.description: Declares, for SCOPE-AID and as one of its governors, its willingness to host pools of RESOURCE-SPEC up to CEILING unit-hours a day (hosting willingness, live until UNTIL when given): the consent a foreign span into this scope's places needs, and the ceiling the means consensus binds. Replies (ok said) or an error. [custody; callable by an enrolled device]

ceiling.description: the most unit-hours a day this scope will host of RESOURCE-SPEC, a positive number

tools.name: session.claim-regime
tools.title: planning: claim-regime
tools.description: Claims, for SCOPE-AID and as one of its governors, the regime of DOMAIN-SPEC (a recipe id): TAILS thin|fat|unknown and PROCESS stable|shifting|unknown. Thin and stable together license statistics in that domain's standing (recipe-standing live-regime-of); anything else reads probability-free. Replies (ok said) or an error. [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

tails.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.declare-means
tools.title: slots: declare-means
tools.description: Seeds or edits this AID's owned resource `means:AID:SPEC` in SCOPE-ID with qty, unit, location and the optionals; replies (ok . resource-id). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

unit.description: a unit symbol, e.g. kg, h, each

arcs-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

note.description: a free-text note recorded on the row or event

emoji.description: an emoji string shown on the need slot

cats-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

criteria-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

tools.name: session.declare-need

tools.description: Declares or edits this AID's standing need intent `need:AID:SPEC` in SCOPE-ID with window, note, emoji, bounds and the optionals; replies (ok (id . intent-id)) or an error. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

qty.description: the quantity of SPEC in UNIT, a positive number

unit.description: a unit symbol, e.g. kg, h, each

arcs-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

note.description: a free-text note recorded on the row or event

emoji.description: an emoji string shown on the need slot

name.description: on announce/leave the caller's display name; on declare-place the human name of the new place; on declare-need/declare-means the row's own display name, default SPEC (need) or "AGENT's SPEC" (means)

cats-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

criteria-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

voice.description: the attached voice mass on a need's own kind claim, a number; default 0

tools.name: session.need-displacement
tools.title: planning: need-displacement
tools.description: Replies what QTY of SPEC currently displaces elsewhere in SCOPE-ID's plan, read off the last solve's duals with the honesty radius; nothing re-solves and an unsolved scope reads nothing. [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

qty.description: the quantity of SPEC in UNIT, a positive number

tools.name: session.externality-history
tools.title: planning: externality-history
tools.description: Replies SCOPE-ID's burn meter: the externality display accumulated one snapshot per solve, summarized as its moved-distribution. [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.ratify-kind
tools.title: planning: ratify-kind
tools.description: Records that SCOPE-ID ratifies SPEC as KIND (floor or held) under this AID's name, or withdraws the grant with des; replies (ok (spec kind)). [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

kind.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.ratified-kinds
tools.title: planning: ratified-kinds
tools.description: Replies SCOPE-ID's ratification grants as rows of spec, kind, by and at. [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.audit-kinds
tools.title: planning: audit-kinds
tools.description: Audits SCOPE-ID's held and floor need rows against what their citizens actually took, withdrawing padded grants and recording every verdict under this AID; OPTIONS may carry consequence-factor and tolerance overrides. Replies examined, padded and findings. [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

options.description: an audit's overrides as a JSON object: consequence-factor (default 1) and tolerance (default 0.25)

tools.name: session.audits
tools.title: planning: audits
tools.description: Replies SCOPE-ID's recorded audit findings from the plan-store's audits meta. [planning; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-slots
tools.title: slots: my-slots
tools.description: Replies this AID's own standing needs and non-retired means in SCOPE-ID as (needs means) rows with qty, unit, place, note, emoji and window arcs. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.our-slots
tools.title: slots: our-slots
tools.description: Replies the fold's reading at SCOPE-ID, needs and means summed per cell with nobody named, each carrying `mine`, this AID's own share joined from HOME-SCOPE-ID. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.retire-need
tools.title: slots: retire-need
tools.description: Withdraws this AID's standing need for SPEC in SCOPE-ID by removing the intent entirely; replies (ok . intent-id). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.retire-means
tools.title: slots: retire-means
tools.description: Withdraws this AID's offer of SPEC in SCOPE-ID by lowering the means to zero, keeping the record and its history; replies (ok . resource-id). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.request-payout
tools.title: stock: request-payout
tools.description: Records this AID's standing intent to have the commons send XMR of its claim to ADDRESS by DUE, checked against what is available; replies (ok (id available)) or an error. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

address.description: the external Monero address the payout is sent to

xmr.description: the amount of XMR to send, a number in whole monero

note.description: a free-text note recorded on the row or event

tools.name: session.my-payouts
tools.title: stock: my-payouts
tools.description: Replies this AID's payout standing in SCOPE-ID: available claim, what the commons owes it, and its payout intents with state. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.scope-readings
tools.title: stock: scope-readings
tools.description: What every source says of SPEC in SCOPE-ID: the reading fold's rows, drift and freshest reading (planner scope-readings), for the inventory face. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.readings-between
tools.title: stock: readings-between
tools.description: What every source reported of SPEC in SCOPE-ID between FROM and UNTIL (ISO-8601, an empty string leaves an end open): one row per reading in time order, and their fold (planner readings-between), for the inventory face's history line. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-claims
tools.title: stock: my-claims
tools.description: Replies this AID's order book in SCOPE-ID: each want as asked (no row yet), held (the plan's claim commitment, with what remains) or taken, priced at the good's crystallized SNLT. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.retire-payout
tools.title: stock: retire-payout
tools.description: Cancels this AID's own pending payout intent ID in SCOPE-ID; replies (ok (id)) or an error when it is settled or belongs to someone else. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

id.description: on open/cast/close/get-result a proposal id; on retire-payout/settle-payout a payout intent id; on add-scope! a scope id

tools.name: session.record-purchase
tools.title: stock: record-purchase
tools.description: Raises QTY of SPEC bought or donated by this AID for the commons, linked to any planned commitment it fulfils; replies resource and event ids plus cost, money-spec and planned? unless it was a gift. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

qty.description: the quantity of SPEC in UNIT, a positive number

unit.description: a unit symbol, e.g. kg, h, each

cost.description: what the purchase cost in MONEY-SPEC units, a number; 0 only when donated

note.description: a free-text note recorded on the row or event

receipt.description: a receipt reference string for the purchase, "" when none

donation?.description: #t when the purchase was donated to the commons and nothing is owed back

tools.name: session.declare-skill
tools.title: slots: declare-skill
tools.description: Self-declares this AID's labour-power SKILL-SPEC-ID in SCOPE-ID as a held skill resource, re-raising a revoked one, and refolds the labour pool; replies (ok . resource-id). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.revoke-skill
tools.title: slots: revoke-skill
tools.description: Withdraws this AID's self-declared SKILL-SPEC-ID in SCOPE-ID by lowering it to zero, keeping the record; replies (ok . resource-id). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-skills
tools.title: slots: my-skills
tools.description: Replies (ok (skills . ids)), the skills this AID currently holds in SCOPE-ID. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.my-skill-standing
tools.title: slots: my-skill-standing
tools.description: Replies (ok (standing . rows)), one row per skill this AID holds or has practiced in SCOPE-ID, in hours: validated hours, where the skill's competence stands today under its own law, work events, how many reached a witness quorum, distinct co-signers, witnessed hours, and ceremonies still collecting. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.observe-contrary-preimage
tools.title: slots: observe-contrary-preimage
tools.description: The SAID-relevant fields of this AID's contrary observation on SCOPE-ID's map — PROCESS's ACTION on SPEC read READING where the map states NOMINAL, on the WITNESS of a work event of this AID's on that process, AT — for the client to re-derive and sign with its own key; refused unless the witness is this AID's own run of that process. docs/planning/voice/feasibility-follows-the-map.md. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

action.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.observe-contrary-signed
tools.title: slots: observe-contrary-signed
tools.description: Lands the observation whose preimage observe-contrary-preimage gave, SIGNATURE this AID's own over its SAID, superseding this AID's earlier observation on the same process and action; the scope's next solve reads it in every future, in the cautious direction only; replies (ok said). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

action.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.observe-contrary
tools.title: slots: observe-contrary
tools.description: The unsigned fallback of observe-contrary-signed for a session with no resident key; replies (ok said). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

action.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.contrary-observations
tools.title: slots: contrary-observations
tools.description: Replies (ok . rows), every standing contrary observation on SCOPE-ID's map: (observer process action spec nominal reading witness observed-at). [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.slots-at
tools.title: slots: slots-at
tools.description: Replies SCOPE-ID's whole live slot pool: every citizen's standing needs and the means held by grant, each with `drawn` from the last solve; a merely declared private means stays out. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

eur-per-hour.description: the euro value of one labour hour, used to price the bills

members-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

needs-json.description: a JSON document, as a string

purse.description: the household's weekly money on hand, a number in euros

labour-h.description: the household's labour hours on hand this week

weighted?.description: #t to weight the split by each member's contributed hours rather than equally

tools.name: session.match-slots
tools.title: slots: match-slots
tools.description: Replies the ring for SCOPE-ID: every standing need scored against every declared means by classification affinity and time, through LENS when given; replies needs, means and matches. [slots; callable by an enrolled device]

lens.description: a named cut of the taxonomy, resolved against this AID's own contact book; absent = the global cut

tools.name: session.set-position
tools.title: places: set-position
tools.description: Records where this AID is at PERIOD (0 = now, later = expected) as known place id PLACE, the planner's commute origin; #f clears; replies (ok . place) or (ok . cleared). [places; callable by an enrolled device]

period.description: a period index into the plan horizon; 0 is now, later integers are future periods

tools.name: session.set-position-latlon

tools.description: Snaps LAT/LON to SCOPE-ID's nearest known place server-side and records that place as this AID's position at PERIOD, so a shared position is a place rather than a trace; replies (ok . place). [places; callable by an enrolled device]

period.description: a period index into the plan horizon; 0 is now, later integers are future periods

lon.description: longitude in decimal degrees; 0 with lat 0 means no coordinates

tools.name: session.set-location-sharing
tools.title: places: set-location-sharing
tools.description: Declares whether this AID shares where they are: MODE live (a watched fix), here (one fix) or off, stated once at their home so every device reads the same; off ends the fix that stands and refuses the next; replies (ok . mode). [places; callable by an enrolled device]

mode.description: a symbol, sent as its name

tools.name: session.location-sharing
tools.title: places: location-sharing
tools.description: Replies the mode this AID declared for sharing where they are (live, here or off), or undeclared; nothing is written. [places; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.set-home
tools.title: places: set-home
tools.description: Registers this AID's home in SCOPE-ID, the place every position rule falls back to: a known place id, or "" with LAT/LON to declare the AID's own `place:AID:home`; replies (ok (place . id)). [places; callable by an enrolled device]

lat.description: latitude in decimal degrees; 0 with lon 0 means no coordinates

lon.description: longitude in decimal degrees; 0 with lat 0 means no coordinates

tools.name: session.declare-dwelling
tools.title: places: declare-dwelling
tools.description: Declares the dwelling this AID lives in, at PLACE ("" = the registered home): its floor area in m² and its rooms, shared by the beds it houses a night, the warmth it is kept at in winter and in summer in °C, the gates an inspection would attest, whether that certificate stands, its own rent per night where a landlord is paid, and the tenure; replies (ok (resource . id) (place . id) (tags …)). [places; callable by an enrolled device]

warmth-summer.description: the indoor temperature the dwelling reaches in summer, in °C

tools.title: places: declare-place
tools.description: Names a new spatial thing in SCOPE-ID with id `place:AID:slug`, optional coordinates and ADDRESS, re-placing it when named again. PARENT names the place it is inside (a room in a site, a shelf in a room): its id is then `PARENT/slug`, and it stands at its parent's position when it states none. Replies (ok (id)) or an error. [places; callable by an enrolled device]

name.description: on announce/leave the caller's display name; on declare-place the human name of the new place; on declare-need/declare-means the row's own display name, default SPEC (need) or "AGENT's SPEC" (means)

lat.description: latitude in decimal degrees; 0 with lon 0 means no coordinates

lon.description: longitude in decimal degrees; 0 with lat 0 means no coordinates

address.description: the external Monero address the payout is sent to

tools.name: session.count-schedule
tools.title: stock: count-schedule
tools.description: The schedule of counts in SCOPE-ID: a row for each thing the inventory shows that sits in no other, soonest due first, with the lines one visit counts, the counter's hours, the interval between counts (from what the plan stakes on the figure and how far counts have found the ledger off), its class (A, B or C), when it was last counted and when it is due. REGIME (announced, undisclosed, random) sets how the next window falls; absent, announced. Replies (ok (rows)). [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

regime.description: how a planned count is disclosed: announced, undisclosed or random; absent, announced

tools.name: session.plan-counts
tools.title: commitments: plan-counts
tools.description: Lays the counts due in SCOPE-ID, those whose window is open and asked of nobody yet, as directed work offers through the offer loop (so held to its bound on open offers), AT-MOST of them a call (3 when absent), each to COUNTER where one is named and else to the member whose turn it is, the stock's owner passed over while another can count it. A count due later is announced by count-schedule and offered when its window opens. Under REGIME undisclosed or random the commitment is read by its counter alone until its window opens, and the count is blind. Replies (ok (laid due)), with (refused kind) when the offer loop stopped the walk. [commitments; callable by an enrolled device]

regime.description: how a planned count is disclosed: announced, undisclosed or random; absent, announced

at-most.description: the most offers one call lays; absent, 3

tools.name: session.scope-replica
tools.title: stock: scope-replica
tools.description: Replies SCOPE-ID as this AID's device holds a copy of it: one text carrying the scope's goods, places, people, the needs standing in it and the observer's books (its stock and the events behind it), each serialized as its own store keeps it. A device seeds its copy from it on taking a seat and after it flushes what it queued, so the same doors answer there with no gateway in reach. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.count-history
tools.title: stock: count-history
tools.description: Replies the counts of RESOURCE-ID in SCOPE-ID, newest first, LIMIT of them (5 when absent): each count that found the ledger off, as (id at delta unit counter technique evidence mine), DELTA signed as the adjustment landed and EVIDENCE the hash of the picture the count names, "" when none. A count voided by a contest is gone from it. What a member reads to contest a count. [stock; callable by an enrolled device]

resource-id.description: an economic-resource id in the scope (own-means: the titled thing; claim/resource-detail: the good)

limit.description: the maximum number of results to reply

tools.name: session.contests
tools.title: governance: contests
tools.description: Replies the contests open in SCOPE-ID as they stand to this AID: each as (id event-id kind resource worker by reason role), KIND work or count, RESOURCE the stock a count is of (empty for work), ROLE attach when the act is this AID's own (a count's counter attaches the picture), vote when this AID is in the franchise, none otherwise. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

tools.name: session.evidence-part
tools.title: governance: evidence-part
tools.description: Attaches the counter's picture to the contest BALLOT-ID, one part of PARTS (26 at the most), PART a run of its base64 sixteen kilobytes at the most, PART-NO from 0 and in order, HASH the sha256 the count names. Only the counter whose act is contested may attach, and only the picture the count names. The last part joins them, checks the bytes hash to HASH and holds the picture until the ballot settles. Replies (ok . characters-held) or (ok . held), or an error. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

ballot-id.description: the id of a contest ballot, contest: and the contested count's adjustment id

hash.description: a picture's hash as a count names it, sha256: and sixty-four hex digits

part-no.description: which part of a picture this is, from 0

parts.description: how many parts the picture is sent in, 26 at the most

part.description: a run of a picture's base64, sixteen kilobytes at the most

tools.name: session.evidence-chunk
tools.title: governance: evidence-chunk
tools.description: Replies part PART-NO of the picture held for the contest BALLOT-ID, to the counter and the franchise: (ok (part total hash)), PART a run of its base64. An error when no picture is held, or the caller is neither. [governance; callable by an enrolled device]

ballot-id.description: the id of a contest ballot, contest: and the contested count's adjustment id

part-no.description: which part of a picture this is, from 0

container-id.description: the id of the shared container the drop-off or pickup happens in

qty.description: the quantity of SPEC in UNIT, a positive number

unit.description: a unit symbol, e.g. kg, h, each

resource-id.description: an economic-resource id in the scope (own-means: the titled thing; claim/resource-detail: the good)

note.description: a free-text note recorded on the row or event
